name: arrows-2x-1600
js: state.music.mute = true; Object.assign(state.access, DEFAULTS.access, { allArrows: true, arrowSize: 200 }); state.world = clone(DEFAULTS.world); const DIRS = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"]; for (const c of Object.values(state.world.cells)) { if (c.kind === "crossing") for (const d of DIRS) c["cross" + d] = true; else c.ways = DIRS.filter(d => !worldNoWay(c.kind, d)); } worldEnter("3,3", null, false); state.background.figX = 0; state.background.figY = 0; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); window.__report = { arrows: [...document.querySelectorAll("#ways .way-arrow")].map(el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return [el.dataset.way, Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.top), Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height), el.className]; }) };
